CPU/ROM/RAM integration, peripheral interfaces, external drivers and power. Define keyboard use explicitly if adopted.

components.name: Aurelia custom video chip
requirements: Qualify shared 16 KiB controller for both 4 MHz and 6 MHz hosts, worst-case text/sprite fetch schedule, 14.31818 MHz output pipeline, full-array refresh, CPU waits and bidirectional monitor control.
Freeze transistor models, layout, pinout, power, clock/reset, test coverage and package; die/yield figures are estimates.

components.name: Aurelia monochrome monitor custom D/A chip
requirements: Specify reference, transfer function/linearity, output range, settling time, package and required analog stages. Decide custom silicon versus a discrete implementation before assigning die cost.

components.name: Logix color monitor custom controller
requirements: Locate the 16×12-bit palette storage, command decoder, clocking, RGB conversion and external analog drivers
establish whether Monitor I/II share silicon but differ in bandwidth/output stages.

components.name: Mono Monitor II custom controller
requirements: Locate 16×8-bit palette storage, command decode, DAC and analog output
define clock/raster and custom-silicon parameters.

components.name: Artemis DMA chip
requirements: Channels, bus-master handshake, byte/word widths, counters, request lines, priority, refresh interaction and external buffering
freeze die/package/test design.

components.name: Artemis MMU chip
requirements: Translate accepted architecture into implementation: entry storage, comparators, control/register interface, restart/wait timing, die/package/power and tests. Identify any external storage or bus buffers.

components.name: Artemis custom graphics chip
requirements: Clarify that 16 KiB video RAM is external unless explicitly integrated. Define video RAM bus, arbitration, scan timing, font path, output serializers/drivers and package.

components.name: Artemis custom FDD/HDD controller
requirements: Define exact floppy and HDD electrical interfaces, encodings, data separator/PLL, DMA/FIFO and firmware split. Specify what remains external
“HDD supported” is not a complete controller.

components.name: Ball Brothers TV-90 CRT display
requirements: Exact OEM orderable part, supplied assembly boundary, screen/phosphor, scan requirements, life/acceptance limits and what analog/HV components remain to buy.

components.name: Sony KV-1204 12-inch color display components
requirements: Exact OEM supply boundary and permitted purchasable kit, with included component list
quantify RGB-interface modifications, mechanical fit, yield and calibration.

components.name: Motorola DS3000-140A CRT display
requirements: Exact tube or monitor-assembly identification, included electronics, raster/bandwidth and acceptance test
prevent tube-plus-complete-monitor double counting.

components.name: 12-inch medium-resolution RGB CRT display assembly
requirements: Supplier and model are absent. Freeze physical dimensions, dot/stripe pitch, scan range, bandwidth, yoke/HV inclusion and actual volume quote basis.

components.name: Micro Peripherals MP-40 bare printer mechanism
requirements: Orderable revision and contents: head, motors, sensors, frame, carriage/platen, ribbon system, wiring
define excluded controller/PSU/case and incoming tests.

components.name: Seagate ST506 5 MB hard disk drive
requirements: Exact manufacturer/model, interface, formatted versus raw capacity, power/spin-up, dimensions, required controller/cables, defect handling and incoming burn-in.

Selected ST506: 5.0 MB formatted / 6.38 MB unformatted, MFM 5 Mbit/s, 34-pin control and 20-pin data. Budget +12 V 4.5 A startup and +5 V 1 A maximum; qualify controller, spin-up, airflow, harness and mounting. Seagate preliminary OEM manual, April 1981. No cost or qualification claim.

transfer_deliverables: AION-prepared SMC-compatible ready-to-use masks and revisions
Process recipes/adaptation know-how and on-site engineering assistance
Wafer test structures, probe/final-test programs, reliability acceptance criteria
qualification_gates: DRAM retention, sensing and refresh; pixel FIFO and renderer timing
Controller speed, electrical equivalence and system validation
Independent wafer fabrication, packaging, final test and reliability
Qualified order codes and capacity before substitution
supplier_programs.cost_boundary: AION internal recurring fabrication remains the base case. SMC purchased-chip scenarios include supplier margin and contractual royalty allowance; transfer engineering/masks/qualification are one-time costs outside unit manufacturing totals.
